evidence.claim: Disney says it collects two basic types of information, personal information and other information.
Disney says it uses information to operate, understand, optimize, develop or improve its sites, applications, products and services, including with survey research and analytics tools.
Disney points to an Online Tracking Technologies and Advertising section covering Do Not Track and how to disable cookies and make choices about such data collection.
The policy page links to Interest-Based Ads and Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information pages.
Disney describes collecting personal and other information, using it to operate and improve its services, and offers cookie and interest-based advertising choices plus a Do Not Sell or Share link.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 26.16.0+rc2-2026.09.08 (report dated Sept. 15, 2026) found code signatures for 2 known tracker SDK(s): Conviva, Google Firebase Analytics (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
